Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Gulliver's Travels", "unit": 40, "heading": "CHAPTER VII.", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en99-040-0013", "target": "Я и в самом деле заметил, что [[I]]йеху[[/I]] были единственными животными в этой стране, подверженными каким-либо болезням; однако болезней этих было гораздо меньше, чем у лошадей у нас, и подхватывались они не от дурного обращения, какое им выпадает, а от нечистоплотности и жадности этого грязного скота. В их языке для этих недугов нет ничего, кроме общего названия, заимствованного от имени этого животного: [[I]]hnea-yahoo[[/I]], или [[I]]зло йеху[[/I]]; а предписываемое лечение — смесь их собственного помёта и мочи, насильно вливаемая в глотку [[I]]йеху[[/I]]. Позднее я нередко видел, что это средство принималось с успехом, и здесь свободно рекомендую его моим соотечественникам для общего блага как превосходное специфическое средство против всех болезней, происходящих от переполнения.", "source_sha256": "9b6f9404ba793eb5ca55ebd76a1a1424b59cf8e9ea38fc26fdc74e4174172de0", "target_id": "ru-en99-040-0013", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "3b6034bc56f7fc291e00d029c4b02c1b75ba57d03ee4ae8575970a091a083dc2"}, {"source_id": "en99-040-0014", "target": "«Что до учёности, правления, искусств, мануфактур и тому подобного, — признался мой господин, — он находил малое сходство или вовсе никакого между [[I]]йеху[[/I]] той страны и теми, что у нас; ибо он хотел заметить лишь то, какое равенство есть в наших природах. Он слышал, правда, от некоторых любознательных [[I]]гуигнгнмов[[/I]] замечание, что в большинстве стад есть своего рода правящий [[I]]йеху[[/I]] (как у нас в парке обычно бывает какой-нибудь вожак или главный олень), который всегда бывал уродливее телом и злее нравом, чем любой из остальных; что у этого вожака обыкновенно есть любимец, настолько похожий на него самого, насколько удаётся найти, чьё занятие — лизать ноги и зад своего господина и гнать самок-[[I]]йеху[[/I]] в его логово; за что его время от времени награждают куском ослиного мяса. Этого любимца ненавидит всё стадо, и потому он, чтобы защитить себя, всегда держится возле особы своего вожака. Обычно он остаётся в должности, пока не найдётся худший; но в самый миг, когда его отстраняют, его преемник, во главе всех [[I]]йеху[[/I]] того округа, молодых и старых, самцов и самок, приходит всем скопом и обливает его испражнениями с головы до ног. Но насколько это применимо к нашим дворам, фаворитам и министрам, мой господин сказал, что лучше всех определить это могу я».", "source_sha256": "9a355b8480589ac079f59a7b3e5fb6fdc00bf5c119ec3d1bcf56abe8b0b77d0b", "target_id": "ru-en99-040-0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "9ec1e04fc614787273a45c5a7d126ad577dcde571a1332383ac2ab1476e51666"}], "source_language": "English", "part": 4, "book": null, "chapter": 7, "role": "PRINCIPAL_CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en99-040-0015", "tag": "p", "text": "I durst make no return to this malicious insinuation, which debased human understanding below the sagacity of a common hound, who has judgment enough to distinguish and follow the cry of the ablest dog in the pack, without being ever mistaken.", "sha256": "5c33e0f898aa03b60affa5b2cd2d65ee144d78300fd70e22f97dc5e6efd3f13c", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[15]", "source_html_sha256": "25a3db9b702d2b3fc9f5788bd26aa81baa58278841a4f407e9f3c0cf236d36ad", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0016", "tag": "p", "text": "My master told me, “there were some qualities remarkable in the [[I]]Yahoos[[/I]], which he had not observed me to mention, or at least very slightly, in the accounts I had given of humankind.” He said, “those animals, like other brutes, had their females in common; but in this they differed, that the she [[I]]Yahoo[[/I]] would admit the males while she was pregnant; and that the hes would quarrel and fight with the females, as fiercely as with each other; both which practices were such degrees of infamous brutality, as no other sensitive creature ever arrived at.", "sha256": "ecccdf6a75d1bdf8545fc4d445051e11d1176144207bf8f4a1141c3d7ef4d7b9", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[16]", "source_html_sha256": "84b9220c55cbe9924a328e3a5b01a835e6ce6e33ab2767633141155d71f31689", "emphasis_spans": 2, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0017", "tag": "p", "text": "“Another thing he wondered at in the [[I]]Yahoos[[/I]], was their strange disposition to nastiness and dirt; whereas there appears to be a natural love of cleanliness in all other animals.” As to the two former accusations, I was glad to let them pass without any reply, because I had not a word to offer upon them in defence of my species, which otherwise I certainly had done from my own inclinations. But I could have easily vindicated humankind from the imputation of singularity upon the last article, if there had been any swine in that country (as unluckily for me there were not), which, although it may be a sweeter quadruped than a [[I]]Yahoo[[/I]], cannot, I humbly conceive, in justice, pretend to more cleanliness; and so his honour himself must have owned, if he had seen their filthy way of feeding, and their custom of wallowing and sleeping in the mud.", "sha256": "18298f25437a3c572878054ab0c5349160a7bea79da503003833b599632f3dfb", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[17]", "source_html_sha256": "9bf111607484e228787ac731c532e2bc828bbee9d76ff48c5a66cf05a80ad721", "emphasis_spans": 2, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0018", "tag": "p", "text": "My master likewise mentioned another quality which his servants had discovered in several Yahoos, and to him was wholly unaccountable. He said, “a fancy would sometimes take a [[I]]Yahoo[[/I]] to retire into a corner, to lie down, and howl, and groan, and spurn away all that came near him, although he were young and fat, wanted neither food nor water, nor did the servant imagine what could possibly ail him. And the only remedy they found was, to set him to hard work, after which he would infallibly come to himself.” To this I was silent out of partiality to my own kind; yet here I could plainly discover the true seeds of spleen, which only seizes on the lazy, the luxurious, and the rich; who, if they were forced to undergo the same regimen, I would undertake for the cure.", "sha256": "831327975dac383d30eb822ef7e3d228fe91274956ccbf31ddd492e145470305", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[18]", "source_html_sha256": "34d812e6035d48b7c6ca5effacb725529b7c05bbcec9a93dfa2abb2dd3e90425", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0019", "tag": "p", "text": "His honour had further observed, “that a female [[I]]Yahoo[[/I]] would often stand behind a bank or a bush, to gaze on the young males passing by, and then appear, and hide, using many antic gestures and grimaces, at which time it was observed that she had a most offensive smell; and when any of the males advanced, would slowly retire, looking often back, and with a counterfeit show of fear, run off into some convenient place, where she knew the male would follow her.", "sha256": "047643d4a96c168e8d4e01f45b7fb4b03618dffc08e07020f51c580e3528865c", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[19]", "source_html_sha256": "2d1474382c637731e7117e671be643e106c5b0b088e916d0591bfc454459d8fa", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“At other times, if a female stranger came among them, three or four of her own sex would get about her, and stare, and chatter, and grin, and smell her all over; and then turn off with gestures, that seemed to express contempt and disdain.”", "sha256": "5567216fc611daa419ee186d139eae28560e9cc6a0904d6b78577749ce1ca891", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[20]", "source_html_sha256": "e19331f7ec3bcc765cf40b97009c13f9f1e709aef54200eedc78a4e8312f92ed", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0021", "tag": "p", "text": "Perhaps my master might refine a little in these speculations, which he had drawn from what he observed himself, or had been told him by others; however, I could not reflect without some amazement, and much sorrow, that the rudiments of lewdness, coquetry, censure, and scandal, should have place by instinct in womankind.", "sha256": "e0b2405945ae09315c529bc62f193654024bf66569b778c5d86108e99907da1f", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[21]", "source_html_sha256": "b58719a2405fe2e58d8729d1c8678467f576bf4e56e87e430bb7e70f7cde285b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}, {"id": "en99-040-0022", "tag": "p", "text": "I expected every moment that my master would accuse the [[I]]Yahoos[[/I]] of those unnatural appetites in both sexes, so common among us. But nature, it seems, has not been so expert a school-mistress; and these politer pleasures are entirely the productions of art and reason on our side of the globe.", "sha256": "d31ea21d4c94d3961f76f898fc70d967e6d2c5de55a930c3b95a1d18678d8bcd", "role": "paragraph", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[42]/p[22]", "source_html_sha256": "6788b54fc615a07c5eb28b803979d944a1d24f76d1307c785409462e44fc4d11", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "br_count": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": null, "source_container_role": null}]}
